$comment: Exceptions register for the blocking accessibility gate (scripts/check-a11y.mjs). An exception applies when axe's rule matches AND the failing element matches the CSS selector. Every entry needs a WCAG basis, an owner and a review date. Review at each release.

exceptions.reason: Text belonging to a disabled form field (label, helper, counter) is intentionally faded (#9C8B7A). WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 exempts text that is part of an inactive user interface component.
